test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 22 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition:

The witness was reluctant to testify________ fear of retaliation.
solution:
The correct answer is '**2**' i.e. **of**.

 

 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 
 **__Key Points__**
 

 
• The preposition **"of"** is used to indicate the reason or cause of something.
 
• In this sentence, the word **"fear"** is the reason for the witness's reluctance to testify.
 
• **Option 1 ("from")** is incorrect as it does not fit the context of indicating the
